title: Alan Prade as front man of Barnes's band
summary: Reason says the vocalist was the band's entertainer in front and Barnes was its brain.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: And they were French people. Yes. Oh, well, when Alan Freed and Paul Barnes were over there with Nelly Lodger and all those people, did you have a conductor?

Alan Freed was a conductor. Oh, I see. He was a conductor. Well, I wouldn't call it a conductor. I called it a director or an entertainer. And what is it? What is it? I just sat in the band and Paul Lee Barnes was the brain.
Yeah, and he would sing a little bit, too.
Well, all of us. In fact, all of us in the band sang. But Alan Freed was the outstanding, well, stand in front of the band.
